## Notes

Over 10k agents and about 5 million interactions; agents with profiles, emotion, needs, and cognition layers; urban, social, and economic spaces (firms, banks, government); Ray actors, asyncio, MQTT bus; DeepSeek API chosen to avoid rate limits. Experiments on polarization, inflammatory messages, universal basic income, hurricane shock.
